title: Irish Toffee Jubilant Delight
description: A dense, moist cake infused with the sweetness of toffee and the crunch of popcorn, perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: Grease a 20cm (8in) round cake pan and line the bottom with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and a pinch of salt.
In a large bowl, whisk together the softened butter, eggs, Irish cream, and jubilant extract.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined.
Stir in the popped popcorn and toffee syrup.
Pour the batter into the prepared cake pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and let cool in the pan for 5 minutes.
Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
Once the cake is cool, you can drizzle with additional toffee syrup if desired.
